description: A discount parameter is accepted but never applied. One file, direct keyword match.
ticket: Invoice totals ignore the discount for customers who used a promo code. Expected: total = subtotal + tax - discount.

args.summary: InvoiceService.total accepts a discount but returns subtotal + tax.

findings.label: VERIFIED
findings.text: total() never subtracts the discount parameter

hypotheses.text: Callers may already pre-subtract the discount
